verify_resolutions.note: Retrieved the full text of Kootenai County Resolution No. 2025-23 ('Emergency Moratorium - Data Centers') directly from the county's own DocumentCenter. Section 5 sets the term as '182 days following adoption of this moratorium,' adopted March 11, 2025 by roll-call vote of the Board of Commissioners. Counting 182 days after (not including) the March 11 adoption date lands on September 9, 2025, matching the record's existing computed_expiry exactly. The resolution's own retroactivity clause (Section 6) also confirms the February 27, 2025 date already in the record.
